name: Chest-Supported Reverse Fly
research: Bench 30 deg, rot_z 180 so the back pad rises toward -Y (he faces -Y and leans onto it; seat is behind him toward +Y). Pad top surface P(s) = (0, -0.01-0.866s+0.019, 0.4025+0.5s+0.032), normal n=(0,0.5,0.866). Root rot X +60: spine runs (0,-0.866,0.5) = along the pad, chest faces -n. Pelvis joint at s=0.30 plus 0.17 m along n (chest front ~0.17-0.19 m ahead of the pelvis joint): (0,-0.251,0.585)+(0,0.085,0.147) = (0,-0.166,0.732); shoulders reach s~0.77 of 0.84, chin past the top (ACE). Measure with probe_bench (pose names differ, so it may need 'bottom') and slide root along n to a -0.02..+0.02 chest gap. Legs straddle: hips (+-0.11,-0.19,0.69), ankles (+-0.45,0.25,0.074) -> 0.80 m, knees bend ~55 deg toward an outward-down pole so the thighs pass outside the 0.30 m seat (check thigh vs pad edge near the hip). Arms in torso frame: world-down = elev 60, plane 90 (torso leans 60 deg); end = elev 90, plane 5 = level and straight out to the side (world +X), a touch toward the head. Grip axis [0,0.5,0.866] = thumb side toward the head in both (palms in at the bottom, palms down at the top). No clavicle bone change (shoulder-blade squeeze not posed; sign of a retraction rotation is unverified). EMG: prone horizontal abduction PD 41.9, MT 50.6, LT 58.2 % MVIC (Kim & Kang 2020); ACE incline reverse fly. Facts and checks: research/chest_supported_reverse_fly.json.
